# FlowForge: full reference

> FlowForge is open-source (AGPL-3.0), self-hosted workflow automation with AI voice agents. It runs on ordinary PHP shared hosting (Hostinger hPanel, cPanel, DirectAdmin) or a VPS with one cron job: no Docker, no Node.js on the server, no per-task fees. It is an alternative to n8n, Zapier and Make.

- Repository: https://github.com/DeveloperSarim/FlowForge
- Documentation: https://developersarim.github.io/FlowForge/
- Short summary: https://developersarim.github.io/FlowForge/llms.txt
- Releases and downloads: https://github.com/DeveloperSarim/FlowForge/releases
- Latest version: 1.6.3 (October 2026)
- License: GNU AGPL-3.0. Free to use, self-host and modify, with no limits on users, workflows, runs or sites.
- Author: Sarim (DeveloperSarim). Paid installation, managed hosting, setup help and custom integrations: support@sarimtools.com

## Who it is for

Small businesses, agencies and freelancers who already have web hosting and want their own automation server and AI phone agents, without paying per task and without managing Docker or Node.js. The interface is made for non-technical users: guided forms, plain-language schedules, no raw IDs, and it works like an app on phones.

## Features

### Visual workflow builder
- Triggers, actions, If/Else branches and filters on a drag-and-drop canvas (React Flow).
- A "What happens next?" picker to add steps, and a three-pane step editor (Input, Parameters, Output) where you drag fields to map data between steps with `{{ steps.<id>.<field> }}`.
- Execute a single step while building; test runs start immediately.

### 1,690 app integrations
- 8,700 actions and 800 triggers across 24 categories: Gmail, Slack, Google Sheets, Google Drive, Google Calendar, HubSpot, Shopify, WooCommerce, Stripe, PayPal, OpenAI, Telegram, WhatsApp Business, Discord, Notion, Airtable, Trello, Jira, Asana, Microsoft Teams, Zoom, Dropbox, Mailchimp, LinkedIn and many more.
- An HTTP request step and a "Make an API call" action on every app for anything not covered.
- 54 ready-made workflow templates.
- Integrations are JSON/YAML manifests, not PHP classes, so new apps are added without code.

### AI Builder
- Describe a workflow in plain words ("When a Typeform is submitted, add the person to HubSpot and tell #sales on Slack") and it searches the catalog, reads each action's settings, saves the workflow, links the data between steps and says what is left to fill in.
- Uses your own API key: OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, DeepSeek or Qwen, or a custom provider: any OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible API (OpenRouter, Groq, Together, Ollama, LM Studio, LiteLLM) with your own base URL, key, model and thinking effort.

### Custom apps
- When a service isn't in the catalog, the AI Builder (or an MCP agent, with the `create_custom_app` tool) builds it as a custom app from the service's documented API: base URL, sign-in, actions and the fields each returns. Or import any OpenAPI (Swagger) file from Apps → Add a custom app.
- Custom apps get their own credentials and work like any other app. They are saved in `storage/app/integrations`, so updates keep them, and their requests only go to their own API address.

### Workflow import and export
- Export one workflow or all of them as a `.flowforge.json` file and import it on any install. Credentials and password fields are never in the file; custom apps the workflows use travel with it. Imported workflows start switched off and use your saved account for an app when there is exactly one.
- Importing an n8n workflow file opens the AI Builder with an outline of the workflow so it can rebuild it in FlowForge.

### AI voice agents (AI receptionist and calling agent)
- AI agents that answer and make phone calls: a receptionist that books appointments, a caller that qualifies new leads, a reminder line that confirms bookings, a support line, a feedback survey.
- 12 templates, each with a sample conversation: clinic receptionist, salon booking, restaurant reservations, hotel front desk, car service booking, gym class booking, store order help, lead qualification, appointment reminder, customer support line, real estate inquiries, feedback survey. Or describe the business and AI writes the agent.
- Agent studio: persona (name, personality: warm, professional, upbeat or calm; reply length; language), first message and instructions, knowledge (business facts and answers to common questions), bookings (services, opening hours, appointment length, ask for email), and details to capture from each call.
- Free test calls in the browser: a phone-style screen with a voice orb; talk with the microphone or type. Replies come from the AI model in Settings; bookings, transcripts and summaries are saved like real calls. Agents on ElevenLabs speak with their ElevenLabs voice in test calls.
- Real phone calls through Vapi or ElevenLabs (both have free tiers). FlowForge publishes the agent, its booking tool and the phone number to the platform; inbound calls to the number reach the agent, and the agent can call any number.
- Voices: the whole ElevenLabs voice library (more than 11,000 voices in over 30 languages, including Urdu, Hindi and Arabic) with search, language and gender filters and samples, or Vapi's built-in voices. On ElevenLabs' free plan only the default voices work through the API.
- Agents keep answers short, ask one question at a time, read bookings back before confirming, and hang up by themselves after goodbye.
- Call history with recordings, transcripts, summaries, outcomes and captured details, and a Bookings page.
- Webhooks per agent: every finished call or new booking can be POSTed as signed JSON to your own URLs (Make, Zapier, n8n, your server), with retries and a delivery log, no workflow needed.
- Workflows: triggers "When a voice call ends" (`voice.call_ended`) and "When a caller books" (`voice.booking_created`), and the action "Call a phone number" (`voice.place_call`). Templates send bookings to Google Calendar, call summaries to Slack, booking emails, and call every new lead.

### Triggers
- Webhooks, schedules in plain words ("every weekday at 9:00", evaluated in the install's timezone), app triggers that poll for new items, manual runs, an error trigger that starts when another workflow fails, and the voice call and booking triggers.
- One cron job (`* * * * * php artisan schedule:run`) runs every schedule, webhook and app trigger. Webhook runs start on the next cron tick, within about a minute.

### Runs and debugging
- Every run keeps each step's input, output and HTTP request. Retry a run (from the failed step or from the start) or run a single step.
- Automatic retries like Zapier's Autoreplay: a run that fails because an app is down, slow or rate-limited is retried from the failed step after 2 min, 10 min, 1 h, 3 h and 6 h; steps that already worked aren't repeated, and the failure email waits for the last try.
- Per step: try again right away (up to 5 times), keep going when it fails, or turn the step off.
- Email alerts when a workflow fails or the cron job stops.

### MCP server for AI agents
- Each install has an MCP server at `/api/mcp` (Streamable HTTP, JSON-RPC 2.0) so Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code and other agents can search apps and build, test and run workflows and voice agents. Auth: a personal token from Settings → API & MCP; the agent gets that user's permissions.
- Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http flowforge https://your-domain.com/api/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN"`
- Each install also serves its own `/llms.txt` and `/llms-full.txt` with every MCP tool and the full app catalog.

### Team, security and updates
- Roles owner, admin and member, with permissions to view, edit or delete workflows and use the AI Builder.
- Credentials and API keys are encrypted, never sent to the browser and masked in run logs.
- One-click updates: Settings → Updates checks GitHub releases, downloads the update, verifies its SHA-256 checksum, backs up, installs and rolls back if anything fails. Uploading the update zip by hand also works.
- Phone-friendly layout with a bottom tab bar and bottom sheets; light and dark themes.

## Requirements

- PHP 8.2 or newer with pdo_mysql, curl, mbstring, openssl, fileinfo, gd and zip.
- MySQL 5.7+ or MariaDB 10.3+.
- Apache or LiteSpeed with mod_rewrite, or Nginx.
- One cron job every minute.
- About 150 MB of disk plus run history.
- No SSH, Composer or Node.js needed on the server.

## Install

1. Download `flowforge-install-x.y.z.zip` from the latest release.
2. Create an empty MySQL database and user in the hosting panel.
3. Upload and extract the zip into the domain's folder (for example `public_html`). If the File Manager times out, also upload `extract-flowforge.php` and open it in the browser.
4. Open `https://your-domain.com/install`. The setup wizard checks the server, connects the database, creates the admin account, sets the timezone and email alerts.
5. Add the cron job the wizard shows, or click "Set it up for me". It turns green within a minute.

Guides with screenshots: Hostinger hPanel https://developersarim.github.io/FlowForge/#hpanel, cPanel https://developersarim.github.io/FlowForge/#cpanel, VPS with Nginx https://developersarim.github.io/FlowForge/#vps, cron https://developersarim.github.io/FlowForge/#cron.

## Comparison

| | FlowForge | n8n | Zapier | Make |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Self-hosted on your own server | Yes | Yes | No | No |
| Runs on cPanel / hPanel shared hosting | Yes | No (needs a Node.js server) | No (cloud only) | No (cloud only) |
| OSI-approved open-source license | Yes (AGPL-3.0) | No (fair-code) | No | No |
| No per-task or per-operation fees | Yes | Yes when self-hosted | No | No |
| Built-in AI voice agents (calls, bookings, call history) | Yes | Through integrations | Through integrations | Through integrations |

## FAQ

- Is FlowForge free? Yes, open source under the AGPL-3.0 with no limits. Only the optional installation and hosting services are paid.
- Do I need a cron job for every workflow? No, one cron job runs everything.
- Can FlowForge answer phone calls with AI? Yes. Voice agents answer and make calls, answer questions about the business, book appointments and save every call. The live call runs on Vapi or ElevenLabs.
- Is the AI voice agent free? Building agents and browser test calls are free and use your own AI key (Gemini and DeepSeek are free or very cheap). Real phone calls are billed by Vapi or ElevenLabs, which both have free tiers.
- Which languages can voice agents speak? English, Urdu, Hindi, Arabic, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Turkish and many more.
- What if my app isn't in the list? Ask the AI Builder to add it as a custom app, or import its OpenAPI file. For a single request, the HTTP request step works with any API.
- How is it different from n8n? n8n needs a Node.js server, usually a VPS or Docker. FlowForge is PHP, so it runs on the shared hosting most websites already use, and it is under an OSI-approved open-source license.
- Can I use it for my business or clients? Yes. If you change the code and offer the changed version to others over a network, the AGPL requires offering them the source code too.

## Version history

- 1.6.3 (October 2026): release notes in Settings → Updates are shown formatted (headings, bold, lists, code, tables) instead of raw Markdown.
- 1.6.2 (October 2026): voice agent webhooks (finished calls and new bookings sent to your own URLs as signed JSON, with retries and a delivery log) and formatted AI Builder answers (code boxes with copy buttons, tables).
- 1.6.1 (October 2026): automatic retries from the failed step with an Auto-retry switch per workflow, step settings (retry, keep going, turn off), resume-from-failed-step for manual retries, and a custom AI provider for any OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible API.
- 1.6.0 (October 2026): about 500 new apps (1,690 in all), custom apps built by the AI or imported from OpenAPI, workflow import and export (n8n files are rebuilt by the AI), Markdown descriptions shown formatted.
- 1.5.1 (October 2026): voice agent studio (persona, knowledge, FAQs, bookable services), phone-style test calls with ElevenLabs voices, the full ElevenLabs voice library with search and language filters, agents hang up after goodbye, 12 voice templates.
- 1.5.0 (October 2026): AI voice agents through Vapi and ElevenLabs, call history with recordings and transcripts, bookings, free browser test calls, voice workflow triggers and actions.
- 1.4.0 (October 2026): first public, open-source release, with one-click updates from GitHub.
